items.title: AI Inference Costs Plummeting
items.summary: The cost of AI inference has fallen dramatically, with GPT-4 class capabilities now costing less than $1 per million tokens.
items.so_what: This profound reduction in compute costs democratizes AI, enabling widespread deployment and unlocking new business models across all layers.

items.title: Meta's Muse Steals AI Model Spotlight

items.so_what: This intensifies competition at the foundation model layer, demonstrating Meta's growing prowess and challenging established leaders.

items.title: CUDA to MLX: Optimizing for Apple Silicon
